use_case: Predictive maintenance for non-safety plant equipment: anomaly detection and remaining-useful-life estimates for 6 assets (supercompactor hydraulic pump and motor, shredder gearbox, conveyor drive, drum handler, 2 exhaust fan motors)
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance vendor (machine learning models on vendor SaaS; on-site sensor gateway)
data_categories: Vibration, temperature, and motor current from wireless sensors; read-only PLC tags (run hours, loads); maintenance work order history. No personal data in model inputs
consequential_decision_category: None; would escalate to Safety/CI if outputs could change control actions or extend maintenance on exhaust ventilation
human_in_the_loop: Alerts create draft work orders only; the Maintenance and Controls Supervisor approves every action; exhaust fan alerts also go to the RSO; time-based preventive maintenance is never extended because of model output
applicable_laws: No sector AI rule identified; license and Chapter 64E-5 commitments for ventilation and effluent control unchanged; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); 10 CFR Part 37 not directly (gateway security reviewed under POL-01 4.9)
status: Pilot (6 assets since 2026-04); approved with conditions due 2026-10-31
